name: mezmo
description: Check Claude Code's Bash and MCP tool calls with Mezmo Governance, record them in the Mezmo ledger, connect Claude to Mezmo MCP, and send Claude Code telemetry to Mezmo.

governance_access_key.title: Mezmo service key
governance_access_key.description: A standard Mezmo service key: the token of the service account registered for Claude Code in Mezmo Governance. It turns on all three: every Bash and MCP tool call is checked by Mezmo Governance, every tool call is recorded in the Mezmo ledger (Bash and MCP calls with their arguments and result; other built-in tools with only their tool, path, URL host or description and whether they worked), and Claude connects to Mezmo MCP to read the ledger. Leave it empty and none of them work.

api_url.title: Mezmo API URL
api_url.description: Leave empty for production, https://api.mezmo.com. For another Mezmo environment, its API URL, such as https://api.example.test.

mcp_url.title: Mezmo MCP URL
mcp_url.description: Leave as is for production. For another Mezmo environment, its MCP URL, such as https://mcp.example.test/mcp.

governance_enabled.title: Check tool calls with Mezmo Governance
governance_enabled.description: Turn off to let tool calls run without a governance check. Governance from managed settings still applies.

ledger_enabled.title: Record tool calls in the Mezmo ledger
ledger_enabled.description: Turn off to stop sending tool calls to the Mezmo ledger. A ledger URL from managed settings still applies.
